base: v3.2 ProofNet translation bridge plus v3.3 supervised attempt ranker

interpretation.solve_rate_change: No net solve-rate gain over v3.2 on the full 50-row benchmark.
interpretation.budget_change: No net Lean-call reduction over v3.2 under the 24-call cap because hard translated rows still exhaust the cap.
interpretation.positive_signal: Solved rows are ranked very early, typically verifying in two Lean calls, which confirms the v3.3 ranker can surface known-good attempt patterns.
interpretation.main_bottleneck: Translation coverage and target proof synthesis remain the limiting factors: unsupported or stale Lean3/mathlib3 identifiers account for 22 rows, and translated-but-unsolved rows account for most remaining budget.

next_step: Use the v3.4 diagnostics to train a failure-aware gate that predicts when to skip low-yield translated rows, then invest saved calls in translation repair and theorem-specific proof scripts.
